finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: Attacker can inject a malicious filePath that leads to OS command execution
finding.assumptions: The filePath is directly used in the Path.Combine method without validation or sanitization. The _rootDir variable is assumed to be a safe directory path.

parsed.refutation_attempt: Checked for any execution of external processes or use of the resulting path in a system call. The sink calls File.WriteAllText, which only writes data to disk; it does not invoke a shell or run a command. While Path.Combine can create a path that escapes the intended root if filePath contains ".." components, this is a path‑traversal risk, not an OS command injection. No code subsequently interprets or executes the written file. Thus the reported OS command injection claim does not hold.
